meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. My son found out he has a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Tell me why.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
Prove it. Show me, and don't tell me what it shows. Also, I'll note that you entered the zero before you called me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
Turn the screen toward me. Then tell me what else is in that file's history, because a few minutes of pasting isn't a finished essay.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

"The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile." Read me the scene reference again, slowly. I'm writing that down. But a made-up quotation is a question about his writing, not proof of anything else. Did you ask Owen about it before you entered a zero?
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

I'm not defending him, and I won't call him a liar on your word. My child never lies, and you haven't shown me a single thing that says otherwise. You've shown me times and a quotation. Did you ask him, before the zero went in, what the second paragraph was about?
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

That's not a deal, Hale. That's the same punishment with a second step. Take the zero off the gradebook now, before the rewrite is discussed. And nothing goes on his record, in writing, from this meeting.
"Well" is not an answer. Put the removal of the zero and the no-record commitment in an email to me, and I'll tell you then whether I'll discuss a rewrite. I'm running out of time.
